steps.title: Check the project on MahaRERA
steps.detail: Confirm registration, completion date, quarterly progress reports and complaints against the developer.

steps.title: Get the full cost sheet in writing
steps.detail: Confirm the GST slab and every extra: parking, floor rise, PLC, clubhouse, development charges, corpus, advance maintenance.

steps.title: Lawyer reviews title and agreement
steps.detail: Title, commencement certificate, approved plans and the draft agreement (RERA model format).

steps.title: Get loan in-principle approval
steps.detail: Confirm your bank has approved this project.

steps.title: Pay booking amount safely
steps.detail: Pay at most 10% before a registered agreement, only into the project's RERA designated account.

steps.title: Register the agreement for sale
steps.detail: Pay stamp duty and registration; deduct and file TDS if applicable.

steps.title: Pay against construction stages
steps.detail: Link payments to construction milestones, not dates. Keep every receipt.

steps.title: Take possession carefully
steps.detail: Get the OC copy, do a snag inspection, collect the possession letter and society membership.

steps.title: Confirm the OC is issued
steps.detail: The occupancy certificate must be issued (not just applied for) and cover this flat.

steps.title: Get the full cost sheet
steps.detail: Parking, corpus, advance maintenance and society charges in writing.

steps.title: Lawyer title search and agreement review
steps.detail: Check title and that the agreement matches the cost sheet.

steps.title: Loan sanction
steps.detail: Bank completes its legal and technical checks.

steps.title: Register the agreement
steps.detail: Pay stamp duty, registration and TDS if applicable.

steps.title: Possession and transfers
steps.detail: Society share certificate, electricity and property tax in your name.

steps.title: Verify the seller's identity
steps.detail: Match the seller's ID with Index II, the share certificate and society records, in person.

steps.title: Lawyer title search
steps.detail: 30-year title search, IGR Index II and CERSAI search for existing charges.

steps.title: Society NOC and dues
steps.detail: Get the NOC, a dues-clearance letter and the transfer charge in writing.

steps.title: Get the seller bank's letters
steps.detail: Foreclosure statement with validity date and a list of original documents held by the bank.

steps.title: Loan sanction and valuation
steps.detail: Bank valuation and building residual-life check; renegotiate if valuation is low.

steps.title: Token, agreement and registration
steps.detail: Pay token by bank transfer against a receipt; register the agreement; pay stamp duty and TDS.

steps.title: Pay off the seller's loan directly
steps.detail: Pay the seller's bank, collect the originals and the loan closure letter.

steps.title: Society and utility transfers
steps.detail: Share certificate endorsement, electricity and property tax transfer.
